# Release notes for v1.0.21

- Deleting or editing an older history entry no longer fails with a permission error. This could happen on accounts whose lifetime unit total was first filled in before a tracker was deleted. The total now stops at zero instead.
- Settings shows each tracker's full name. On phones the tracker list cut long names short or broke them mid-word; the name now has its own line, with the daily limit and type underneath.
- TalkBack names the day on every History entry's edit and delete buttons, and the tracker on every reorder button, so rows are no longer announced identically.
